title.en: Isle of May puffin numbers plummet after extreme weather
title.zh: 极端天气后梅岛海鹦数量锐减

summary.en: Numbers of puffins on the Isle of May, a significant UK colony, may have dropped by 30% due to a decline in food availability and extreme weather events, including storms and rising ocean temperatures affecting sand eels, their primary food source.
summary.zh: 由于食物供应减少和极端天气事件，包括影响沙鳗（海鹦的主要食物来源）的风暴和海洋温度上升，英国重要的梅岛海鹦种群数量可能下降了30%。

body.en:
Puffin numbers in one of the UK's largest colonies have suffered after a drop in food supplies and extreme weather conditions, conservationists have warned.

NatureScot said the number of burrows occupied by the seabirds on the Isle of May in the Firth of Forth had fallen by 30% in the last two years.

A joint survey also involving the UK Centre for Ecology & Hydrology (UKCEH) suggested violent storms had killed a number of the birds, while rising ocean temperatures had seriously harmed populations of sand eels - their main source of food.

About 36,500 burrows on the island – about 4.9 miles (8km) off the coast of Fife - were found to be in active use during the study carried out over the summer.

That marked a drop of nearly a third from the 52,000 burrows thought to be in use during the last survey of its kind in 2024.

The Isle of May has been a national nature reserve (NNR) since 1956 and has been home to almost 300 species of birds.

The reserve's manager, David Steel, said the drop was reminiscent of the early 2000s, when puffin numbers fell before recovering in the 2010s.

"The decrease appears to be linked to a combination of ongoing pressures on seabird food supplies, poor winter survival and increasingly extreme weather conditions," he said.

"All of this underlines the importance of continued monitoring and conservation work at sites like the Isle of May NNR, where data and research are playing a vital role in helping us to understand these trends and respond."

The survey involved researchers sweeping back and forth across the island over a six-day period, counting burrows and assessing whether they were used by puffins or rabbits.

The island is also home to guillemots, fulmars, terns and gulls, thanks to its lack of predators.

In the autumn and winter months, it also plays host to thousands of breeding seals, while about 250 species of migrating birds use it as a stopover point.

Mark Newell, UKCEH's field manager on the Isle of May, said he was concerned future "extreme weather events" could affect the breeding ability of puffins and other species.

He said: "We believe that the puffin population has recently suffered from a series of extreme climate events, including marine heat waves and intense storms affecting survival in three of the last five winters.

"The concern for puffins and other seabirds is that climate scientists are predicting an increase in the frequency and severity of extreme events."
body.zh: 自然资源保护人士警告说，由于食品供应下降和极端天气条件，英国最大的栖息地之一的海鹦数量受到了影响。 NatureScot表示，福斯湾五月岛上的海鸟占据的洞穴数量在过去两年里减少了30%。 英国生态与水文学中心 (UKCEH) 参与的一项联合调查显示，猛烈的风暴导致许多鸟类死亡，而海洋温度上升严重损害了沙鳗的数量，而沙鳗是沙鳗的主要食物来源。 在夏季进行的研究中，距离法夫海岸约 8 公里（4.9 英里）的岛上约有 36,500 个洞穴正在被积极使用。 这标志着 2024 年上次同类调查中被认为正在使用的 52,000 个洞穴减少了近三分之一。 自 1956 年以来，五月岛一直是国家自然保护区 (NNR)，是近 300 种鸟类的家园。 该保护区经理戴维·斯蒂尔 (David Steel) 表示，这种下降让人想起 2000 年代初，当时海鹦数量下降，然后在 2010 年代恢复。 他说：“这种减少似乎与海鸟食物供应的持续压力、冬季生存能力差和日益极端的天气条件有关。” “所有这些都强调了在五月岛 NNR 等地点持续开展监测和保护工作的重要性，那里的数据和研究在帮助我们了解这些趋势并做出应对方面发挥着至关重要的作用。” 这项调查涉及研究人员在六天内来回扫荡整个岛屿，计算洞穴并评估它们是否被海雀或兔子使用。 由于缺乏掠食者，该岛也是海鸠、管鼻蝠、燕鸥和海鸥的家园。 在秋季和冬季，这里还是数千只繁殖海豹的栖息地，同时还有约 250 种候鸟将这里作为中途停留地。 UKCEH 五月岛现场经理马克·纽厄尔 (Mark Newell) 表示，他担心未来的“极端天气事件”可能会影响海雀和其他物种的繁殖能力。 他说：“我们认为海雀种群最近遭受了一系列极端气候事件，包括海洋热浪和强烈风暴，在过去五个冬天中的三个冬天影响了生存。 “对海雀和其他海鸟的担忧是，气候科学家预测极端事件的频率和严重程度将会增加。”

reflection.en: The puffins of the Isle of May face a stark challenge as extreme weather and warming seas disrupt their food supply. This reminds us of the intricate web of life in creation, where even small changes can have profound effects. The Psalmist marvels at the wisdom woven into the natural world, a wisdom that sustains life but is also vulnerable to the...
reflection.zh: 梅岛上的海鹦面临严峻的挑战，因为极端天气和海洋变暖扰乱了它们的食物供应。这提醒我们，造物中生命环环相扣，即使微小的变化也会产生深远的影响。诗人惊叹于自然界中蕴含的智慧，这种智慧维系着生命，但也容易受到我们所目睹的干扰的影响。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Mixed grazing, controlled burns and collaboration can curb Mediterranean wildfire risks
title.zh: 混合放牧、控制烧毁和合作可以遏制地中海野火风险

summary.en: Wildfires in the Mediterranean region are becoming drastically more intense. The recent major fires in France, Spain and Greece show that firefighting efforts are reaching their limits. An international research team is calling for a fundamentally new approach to landscape design, integrating wildfire prevention with...
summary.zh: 地中海地区的野火正变得越来越猛烈。法国、西班牙和希腊最近发生的大火表明，消防努力正达到极限。一个国际研究团队呼吁采取一种根本性的新景观设计方法，将野火预防与自然保护和农业相结合。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Wildfires in the Mediterranean region are becoming drastically more intense. The recent major fires in France, Spain and Greece show that firefighting efforts are reaching their limits.

An international research team led by the University of Göttingen and the University of Kassel is therefore calling for a fundamentally new approach to landscape design: In the journal iScience , the researchers demonstrate that wildfire prevention should be conceived and planned in conjunction with nature conservation, agriculture and rural development.

Using 10 landscape planning initiatives in the Mediterranean region as a basis, the team investigated how they affected wildfire risk. The models ranged from extensive grazing with cattle, sheep and goats (to reduce combustible biomass) to controlled burning and collaboration among the agricultural and forestry sectors, nature conservation organizations, the scientific community and the fire services.

The result: Initiatives that combined different forms of land use, actively involved various social groups and continuously refined their measures proved particularly successful. The researchers are therefore advocating a shift in wildfire management from a predominantly reactive approach to firefighting toward a long-term, preventive approach to shaping resilient landscapes.

"Wildfires are not just a problem for the forestry sector, but the result of complex interactions between climate, land use and societal developments. Our findings show that successful wildfire prevention combines ecological, economic and social objectives and brings relevant stakeholders together," explains lead author Dr. Elsa Varela from the Spanish National Research Council (CSIC), who coordinated the study as a Humboldt Fellow at the Chair of Socio-Ecological Interactions in Agricultural Systems at the Universities of Göttingen and Kassel.

"A new landscape-based approach offers the opportunity to combine wildfire prevention with biodiversity conservation and sustainable land use. This leads to solutions that are ecologically effective and socially viable," emphasizes Professor Tobias Plieninger from the same chair. "This requires stable partnerships, long-term funding and joint learning processes between science, policy and practice."

Elsa Varela et al, Capitalizing on integrated landscape approaches for wildfire risk mitigation in the Mediterranean region, iScience (2026). DOI: 10.1016/j.isci.2026.116741

BSc Life Sciences & Ecology. Microbiology lab background with pharmaceutical news experience in oil, gas, and renewable industries. Full profile...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 地中海地区的野火正变得更加猛烈。最近法国、西班牙和希腊发生的重大火灾表明，消防工作已达到极限。 因此，由哥廷根大学和卡塞尔大学领导的一个国际研究小组呼吁采用一种全新的景观设计方法：研究人员在《iScience》杂志上证明，应将野火预防与自然保护、农业和农村发展结合起来进行构思和规划。 该团队以地中海地区的 10 项景观规划举措为基础，调查了它们如何影响野火风险。这些模式包括牛、绵羊和山羊的广泛放牧（以减少可燃生物量）、控制燃烧以及农业和林业部门、自然保护组织、科学界和消防部门之间的合作。 结果是：结合不同土地利用形式、积极参与各种社会团体并不断完善措施的举措被证明是特别成功的。因此，研究人员主张将野火管理从主要的反应性灭火方法转变为长期的预防性方法，以塑造具有复原力的景观。 “野火不仅是林业部门的问题，也是气候、土地利用和社会发展之间复杂相互作用的结果。我们的研究结果表明，成功的野火预防结合了生态、经济和社会目标，并将相关利益相关者聚集在一起，”西班牙国家研究委员会 (CSIC) 的主要作者 Elsa Varela 博士解释道，她作为洪堡研究员、哥廷根大学和哥廷根大学农业系统社会生态相互作用主席协调了这项研究。卡塞尔。 “基于景观的新方法提供了将野火预防与生物多样性保护和可持续土地利用结合起来的机会。这导致了生态有效且社会可行的解决方案，”同一主席的托比亚斯·普利宁格（Tobias Plieninger）教授强调道。 “这需要科学、政策和实践之间稳定的伙伴关系、长期资助和联合学习过程。” Elsa Varela 等人，利用综合景观方法缓解地中海地区野火风险，iScience (2026)。 DOI：10.1016/j.isci.2026.116741 生命科学与生态学理学士。微生物学实验室背景，具有石油、天然气和可再生行业的制药新闻经验。完整档案...

reflection.en: The escalating wildfires in the Mediterranean are a stark reminder of nature's power and the limits of human intervention. As researchers propose integrating conservation and agriculture, we see a call to work *with* creation's intricate systems, not just against its destructive forces. This echoes the Psalmist's awe at the 'vastness' and 'wisdom' evident...
reflection.zh: 地中海地区日益加剧的野火，严峻地提醒我们大自然的力量以及人类干预的局限性。研究人员提出将自然保护与农业相结合，这呼吁我们与造物主精妙的系统一同工作，而不仅仅是对抗其破坏性的力量。这呼应了诗篇作者对雅伟多样化工作中显而易见的“浩瀚”和“智慧”的敬畏，敦促我们在自然界中寻求理解与和谐。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Alcohol-related cancer deaths in US have more than doubled over three decades
title.zh: 美国酒精相关癌症死亡人数三十年翻倍

summary.en: A study reveals that alcohol-related cancer deaths in the US have more than doubled over the past three decades, with research indicating that even one drink per day can increase cancer risk, extending beyond liver cancer.
summary.zh: 一项研究发现，美国与酒精相关的癌症死亡人数在过去三十年里翻了一番多。研究表明，即使每天只饮用一杯酒也会增加患癌症的风险，并且这种影响已超出肝癌的范畴。

body.en: Study finds just one drink per day could raise risk of disease with impacts extending far beyond liver cancer Alcohol-related cancer deaths in the US have more than doubled over three decades, with new research showing that just one drink per day could raise cancer risk and that the impacts extend far beyond liver cancer. Researchers at Sylvester Comprehensive Cancer Center, part of the University of Miami Miller School of Medicine, analyzed more than three decades of Global Burden of Disease data. Their study, published in August in the Lancet Regional Health , found that annual cancer deaths attributed to alcohol climbed from 11,361 in 1990 to 23,126 in 2023. Continue reading...
body.zh: 研究发现，每天只喝一杯酒就会增加患癌症的风险，其影响远远超出肝癌范围。三十年来，美国与酒精相关的癌症死亡人数增加了一倍多，新的研究表明，每天只喝一杯酒就可能增加癌症风险，其影响范围远远超出肝癌范围。迈阿密大学米勒医学院下属的西尔维斯特综合癌症中心的研究人员分析了三十多年来的全球疾病负担数据。他们的研究发表在 8 月份的《柳叶刀地区健康》杂志上，发现每年因酒精导致的癌症死亡人数从 1990 年的 11,361 人攀升至 2023 年的 23,126 人。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This report from the US paints a sobering picture of how lifestyle choices can have profound and escalating health consequences. The doubling of alcohol-related cancer deaths over thirty years is a stark reminder of the pervasive impact of disease and the need for awareness and care. As James 5:14 encourages prayer for the sick, it also calls us to consider...
reflection.zh: 这份来自美国的研究描绘了一幅令人警醒的画面，揭示了生活方式的选择如何会带来深远且不断升级的健康后果。三十年来，与酒精相关的癌症死亡人数翻倍，这鲜明地提醒我们疾病的普遍影响，以及提高认识和关怀的必要性。正如雅各书5:14鼓励为病人祷告一样，它也促使我们反思那些可预防的痛苦根源，并在日常习惯中寻求智慧。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

title.en: At least 37 killed by toxic fumes during alleged petrol theft in Nigeria, reports say
title.zh: 尼日利亚据报因涉嫌盗窃汽油引发有毒气体死亡事件至少37人丧生

summary.en: An environmental group reports that at least 37 people have died from inhaling toxic fumes while allegedly stealing petrol from a pipeline in Nigeria's Rivers State. Over 100 people were reportedly involved in the incident, with many still missing.
summary.zh: 一个环保组织报告称，在尼日利亚河流州，至少有37人在试图从管道盗窃汽油时因吸入有毒气体而死亡。据称有100多人参与了此次事件，许多人仍下落不明。

body.en:
At least 37 people have died after inhaling toxic fumes while allegedly stealing petrol from a pipeline in Nigeria's Rivers State, an environmental group in the oil-rich region says.

Many are still missing after more than 100 people descended on Okari Jetty in Okrika in small boats to collect the refined fuel under cover of darkness, according to the Youths and Environmental Advocacy Centre (YEAC).

The police told the BBC an investigation was ongoing to determine the figures of those affected after people reportedly collapsed - with local reports saying some fell into the Bonny River while others were taken to hospital.

Rivers is one of several states that make up the southern Niger Delta region, a vast area of swamps and wetlands with huge reserves of oil and gas along Nigeria's coast.

For years, criminal groups have tapped pipelines and siphon crude oil or other petroleum products into boats and storage tanks, to be sold on the black market or taken to illegal refineries.

The YEAC said its network of volunteers and human rights defenders had reported that people in Okrika had died after inhaling what it locally known as "Indorama fuel", which is a form of refined petrol known as PMS (Premium Motor Spirit).

Nigeria's Security and Civil Defence Corps (NSCDC) has urged the public and media to rely on verified information as they work with other security agencies to establish what happened in the early hours of Thursday morning.

It condemned illegal tapping and siphoning, warning that such activities put lives, the environment and the economy at risk.

Similarly, many campaigners have also blamed the practice for contributing to environmental damage.

On Thursday, the director of navel information, Capt Abiodun Folorunsho, warned thieves there was "no hiding place" from the navy, which patrols the waterways and coastal areas of the Niger Delta.

"Their days are numbered, and if we catch you, of course, we'll ensure that you face the law," he said in an interview with Nigerian broadcaster Channels TV.

While the Nigerian navy has increased maritime security operations, the military and other security agencies have carried out operations against oil thieves, who often hid out in the area's dense mangrove forests.

Nigeria is trying to increase oil production after years of problems caused by theft, insecurity and underinvestment.

The country aims to raise production to about three million barrels per day by 2030 and is relying on better security and reforms to attract new investment.
body.zh: 石油资源丰富地区的一个环保组织称，至少 37 人因涉嫌从尼日利亚河流州的管道偷窃汽油而吸入有毒烟雾而死亡。 据青年与环境倡导中心 (YEAC) 称，在 100 多人乘坐小船在夜色掩护下来到奥克里卡的奥卡里码头收集精炼燃料后，仍有许多人失踪。 警方告诉英国广播公司，一项调查正在进行中，以确定据报道有人倒塌后受影响的人数——当地报道称，一些人掉入邦尼河，另一些人被送往医院。 里弗斯是构成尼日尔三角洲南部地区的几个州之一，该地区是尼日利亚沿海大片沼泽和湿地，蕴藏着巨大的石油和天然气储量。 多年来，犯罪团伙利用管道将原油或其他石油产品虹吸到船只和储罐中，然后在黑市上出售或运往非法炼油厂。 YEAC 表示，其志愿者和人权捍卫者网络报告称，奥克里卡的人们在吸入当地称为“Indorama 燃料”的物质后死亡，这种燃料是一种被称为 PMS（高级汽车精神）的精炼汽油。 尼日利亚安全和民防部队（NSCDC）敦促公众和媒体在与其他安全机构合作确定周四凌晨发生的事件时依赖经过验证的信息。 它谴责非法窃听和虹吸，警告此类活动将生命、环境和经济置于危险之中。 同样，许多活动人士也指责这种做法造成了环境破坏。 周四，海军情报局局长阿比奥敦·弗洛伦索上尉警告窃贼，在尼日尔三角洲的水道和沿海地区巡逻的海军“没有藏身之处”。 他在接受尼日利亚广播公司 Channels TV 采访时说：“他们的日子已经屈指可数了，如果我们抓住你，我们当然会确保你接受法律制裁。” 虽然尼日利亚海军加强了海上安全行动，但军方和其他安全机构也对经常躲藏在该地区茂密红树林中的石油窃贼开展了行动。 在经历了多年的盗窃、不安全和投资不足造成的问题后，尼日利亚正在努力增加石油产量。 该国的目标是到 2030 年将产量提高到约 300 万桶/日，并依靠更好的安全和改革来吸引新投资。

reflection.en: This tragedy in Nigeria's Rivers State, where desperation led to loss of life from toxic fumes during alleged petrol theft, speaks to a deep imbalance. The pursuit of resources without regard for safety or legality, and the resulting devastation, calls to mind the prophet Micah's call to "act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God." True...
reflection.zh: 尼日利亚河流州发生的这起悲剧，绝望导致在涉嫌盗窃汽油时因有毒气体而丧生，这反映了一种深刻的不平衡。不顾安全或合法性地追求资源，以及由此造成的毁灭，令人想起先知弥迦的呼吁：“只当公义行道，喜爱怜悯，谦卑与你的雅伟同行。”真正的繁荣和福祉不在于非法所得，而在于道德行为和彼此关爱。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Milky Way at the dining table: Bath art show celebrates 18th-century brother and sister astronomers
title.zh: 巴斯展览突出姊妹发现——以及英格兰首位有薪女天文学家

summary.en: An exhibition in Bath showcases artworks in a Georgian townhouse where siblings William and Caroline Herschel lived and conducted groundbreaking astronomical research in the late 18th century, celebrating their pioneering spirit.
summary.zh: 在巴斯的一处乔治亚风格联排别墅中，一项新的艺术展览展示了威廉和卡罗琳·赫歇尔兄妹的生活和工作。这对兄妹在18世纪末在这里进行了一系列非凡的天文发现，展览突出了他们开创性的精神。

body.en: Exhibition opens in former home of William Herschel, who discovered Uranus, and his comet-spotting sibling Caroline From the garden of their Georgian townhouse in Bath in the late 18th century, a brother and sister made a series of extraordinary astronomical discoveries. A new art show in the house where the siblings – William and Caroline Herschel – worked and lived highlights their pioneering spirit and their domestic arrangements. Continue reading...
body.zh: 展览展出了威廉·赫歇尔 (William Herschel) 和卡罗琳·赫歇尔 (Caroline Herschel) 在 18 世纪末工作和生活的联排别墅中的艺术品。 18 世纪末，一对兄妹在巴斯 (Bath) 乔治亚风格联排别墅的花园里做出了一系列非凡的天文发现。威廉·赫歇尔和卡罗琳·赫歇尔兄妹工作和生活的房子里举办了一场新的艺术展，凸显了他们的开拓精神和家庭安排。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The exhibition in Bath celebrates the remarkable astronomical work of William and Caroline Herschel. Their dedication to their craft, carried out in their home, reminds us that all honest labor, whether in science or art, can be a form of service. Colossians 3:23 calls us to do everything with our whole heart, as if working for Yahweh Himself, bringing a...
reflection.zh: 巴斯的展览颂扬了威廉和卡罗琳·赫歇尔兄妹非凡的天文工作。他们在家中对技艺的专注，提醒我们所有诚实的工作，无论是在科学还是艺术领域，都可以是一种服务。歌罗西书3:23呼吁我们凡事都从心里做，像是为主做的，为主而做，为人的努力带来了神圣的尊严。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Stanford scientists discover a seafood that can reverse signs of aging
title.zh: 斯坦福科学家发现一种海鲜可以逆转衰老迹象

summary.en: A substance found in edible sea squirts appeared to reverse several signs of aging in older mice. Plasmalogen supplements improved memory and learning, strengthened connections between brain cells, reduced inflammation, and even helped the mice grow thicker, darker hair. Aging often makes itself visible in familiar...
summary.zh: 在可食用的海鞘中发现的一种物质似乎逆转了老年小鼠衰老的若干迹象。类鲸烷补充剂改善了记忆力和学习能力，加强了脑细胞之间的连接，减少了炎症，甚至帮助小鼠长出更浓密、更黑的毛发。衰老常常以熟悉的方式显现，从白发皱纹到记忆力减退。这项研究指向了延缓、预防甚至逆转其中一些变化的可能。

body.en:
Aging often makes itself visible in familiar ways, from gray hair and wrinkles to lapses in memory. That has fueled a longstanding scientific question: Could some of those changes eventually be slowed, prevented, or even reversed?

Research involving a group of scientists from Xi'an Jiaotong-Liverpool University, Stanford University, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, and the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences points to an intriguing possibility. In experiments with aged mice, researchers found that dietary supplements containing compounds associated with Ascidiacea, commonly known as sea squirts, reversed several signs linked to aging.

Sea squirts are marine animals that are eaten in parts of Asia, including Korea (where it is known as meongge , or 멍게) and Japan ( hoya , or ホヤ). They can be eaten raw and contain high levels of compounds called plasmalogens.

Plasmalogens are a type of lipid, or fat molecule, that forms an important part of cell membranes. They occur naturally throughout the human body and are especially abundant in the brain, heart, and immune cells. Their levels tend to decline as people grow older.

Reduced plasmalogen levels have also been observed in several neurodegenerative diseases, including Alzheimer's disease and Parkinson's disease. That connection has led researchers to investigate whether restoring plasmalogens could help protect the brain from some of the changes associated with aging.

To explore that possibility, the team added plasmalogens to the diets of aged mice and examined how the supplements affected both their behavior and their bodies.

The results were striking. The treated mice showed substantial improvements in learning and displayed visible physical changes as well.

Professor Lei Fu, the corresponding author of the study, says: "Our research suggests that plasmalogens may not just stop cognitive decline, but may reverse cognitive impairments in the aging brain. Additionally, aged mice fed with the plasmalogens grow new black hair that is thicker and glossier than aged mice not fed the supplement."

According to the researchers, the work provides the first detailed look at how plasmalogens may influence the aging brain.

To measure learning and memory, the scientists used a common laboratory experiment called the Morris water maze. In this test, mice are placed in a pool containing a hidden platform where they can rest.

Because mice generally prefer to escape the water, they gradually learn where the platform is located. After several days of training, younger mice typically remember its position and swim toward it quickly. Older mice often need more time to locate the platform, reflecting the decline in learning and memory that can accompany aging.

After five days of...
body.zh: 衰老常常以人们熟悉的方式显现出来，从白发、皱纹到记忆衰退。这引发了一个长期存在的科学问题：其中一些变化最终是否会被减缓、阻止，甚至逆转？ 来自西交利物浦大学、斯坦福大学、上海交通大学和中国科学院大学的一组科学家的研究指出了一种有趣的可能性。在对老年小鼠进行的实验中，研究人员发现，含有与海鞘（俗称海鞘）相关化合物的膳食补充剂可以逆转与衰老相关的多种迹象。 海鞘是亚洲部分地区食用的海洋动物，包括韩国（在那里被称为 meongge 或 멍게）和日本（hoya 或 ホヤ）。它们可以生吃，并含有高含量的缩醛磷脂化合物。 缩醛磷脂是一种脂质或脂肪分子，形成细胞膜的重要组成部分。它们自然存在于人体各处，尤其在大脑、心脏和免疫细胞中含量丰富。随着人们年龄的增长，它们的水平往往会下降。 在几种神经退行性疾病中也观察到缩醛磷脂水平降低，包括阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病。这种联系促使研究人员研究恢复缩醛磷脂是否有助于保护大脑免受与衰老相关的一些变化。 为了探索这种可能性，研究小组在老年小鼠的饮食中添加了缩醛磷脂，并研究了补充剂如何影响它们的行为和身体。 结果是惊人的。接受治疗的小鼠在学习方面表现出显着改善，并表现出明显的身体变化。 该研究的通讯作者 Lei Fu 教授表示：“我们的研究表明，缩醛磷脂不仅可以阻止认知能力下降，还可以逆转衰老大脑中的认知障碍。此外，喂食缩醛磷脂的老年小鼠会长出新的黑发，比未喂食补充剂的老年小鼠更浓密、更有光泽。” 研究人员表示，这项工作首次详细研究了缩醛磷脂如何影响衰老的大脑。 为了测量学习和记忆，科学家们使用了一种常见的实验室实验，称为莫里斯水迷宫。在这个测试中，小鼠被放置在一个包含隐藏平台的水池中，它们可以在那里休息。 因为老鼠通常更喜欢逃离水，所以它们逐渐知道平台的位置。经过几天的训练，年轻的老鼠通常会记住它的位置并迅速游向它。年长的小鼠通常需要更多的时间来定位平台，这反映出随着衰老而出现的学习和记忆力下降。 经过五天的...

reflection.en: Scientists are exploring ways to combat the physical effects of aging, as seen in this study on sea squirts and mice. While such research offers hope for improved health and vitality, it also reminds us of the natural cycle of life and the inevitability of mortality. Hebrews 9:27 reminds us that 'people are destined to die once, and after that to face...
reflection.zh: 科学家们正在探索对抗衰老生理影响的方法，正如这项关于海鞘和小鼠的研究所示。虽然此类研究为改善健康和活力带来了希望，但它也提醒我们生命的自然循环和死亡的必然性。希伯来书9:27提醒我们，“按定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。”这种视角鼓励我们充实地生活，珍惜生命的每一个季节，同时也要抓住超越尘世存在的终极盼望。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: Extreme drought now covers 44% of Puerto Rico
title.zh: 极端干旱现已覆盖波多黎各44%的地区

summary.en: Puerto Rico is experiencing a severe and rapidly expanding drought, with three-quarters of the territory facing at least moderate drought conditions by August 25th. Extreme drought affects 44% of the area, and some regions are receiving less than 20% of their typical rainfall. This has led to water rationing, crop...
summary.zh: 波多黎各正经历一场严重且迅速蔓延的干旱，截至8月25日，该地区四分之三的地区至少处于中度干旱状态。极端干旱影响了44%的地区，一些地区降雨量仅为往常的20%。这导致了水资源配给、农作物歉收以及牧场饲料短缺，并已引发地方和联邦的灾难声明。

body.en: Puerto Rico’s normally rainy season has instead brought a severe and fast-growing drought. By August 25, three-quarters of the territory was in at least moderate drought, with extreme drought covering 44 percent and some areas receiving less than 20 percent of their usual rainfall. Water shortages have forced rationing, while farmers are losing crops and ranchers are running low on hay. The situation has become serious enough to trigger both local and federal disaster declarations.
body.zh: 波多黎各平常的雨季却带来了严重且快速增长的干旱。截至8月25日，四分之三的领土至少处于中度干旱，极端干旱覆盖44%，一些地区的降雨量还不到平时的20%。水资源短缺迫使人们实行配给，而农民正在失去庄稼，牧场主的干草也越来越少。情况已经严重到足以触发地方和联邦灾难声明。

reflection.en: The drought in Puerto Rico highlights the fragility of life when essential resources like water become scarce. Even when the land seems to withhold its bounty, Habakkuk's ancient words remind us that joy and trust can be found in Yahweh, even amidst severe hardship and apparent desolation. This difficult season calls for resilience and a deep reliance on...
reflection.zh: 波多黎各的干旱凸显了当水等基本资源变得稀缺时，生命的脆弱性。即使土地似乎吝啬其恩赐，哈巴谷古老的言语提醒我们，即使在严峻的困境和明显的荒凉中，喜乐和信靠也能在雅伟里找到。这个艰难的季节呼唤着韧性和对神圣供应的深切依赖。

verse.textEn: Though the fig tree does not bud and there are no grapes on the vines... yet I will rejoice in Yahweh.
verse.textZh: 虽然无花果树不发旺，葡萄树不结果……然而，我要因雅伟欢欣。

title.en: MIT turns bacteria into living transistors
title.zh: 麻省理工学院将细菌转化为活体晶体管

summary.en: Researchers at MIT have developed bacteria that function as transistors, enabling the creation of living circuits capable of performing calculations and controlling chemical signals. These biological computers could potentially be used in applications such as coating plant roots to detect environmental threats.
summary.zh: 麻省理工学院的研究人员开发了可作为晶体管的细菌，从而创造出能够执行计算和控制化学信号的活体电路。这些生物计算机有可能用于诸如涂覆植物根部以检测环境威胁等应用。

body.en:
MIT researchers have engineered bacteria to work like transistors, creating living "circuit boards" that can be printed onto growth material inside a Petri dish.

In conventional electronics, transistors act as switches that control whether electrical current can pass through a circuit. In the MIT system, engineered bacterial cells perform a similar role by regulating the movement of small signaling molecules. Those molecules then carry information to other components in the biological circuit.

The researchers created two types of bacterial transistors and three additional bacterial strains that act as relays between them. Together, these five strains provide a modular set of components that can be arranged to build nearly any kind of circuit. In the new study, the team demonstrated circuits capable of adding two or three inputs and directing a single input toward a selected destination.

"We've built some initial computer architecture components that are commonly used, but any operation can be built with these five strains," says Hamid Doosthosseini PhD '25, an MIT postdoc and the lead author of the new study.

One potential use is to place these living circuits on plant leaves or roots. There, the bacteria could process information about environmental conditions, helping plants detect and respond to stresses such as drought or pest attacks.

Christopher Voigt, head of MIT's Department of Biological Engineering, is the senior author of the paper, which was recently published in Nature Chemical Biology . Former MIT postdoc Haorong Chen is also an author of the paper.

Synthetic biology circuits are usually built by engineering cells to produce proteins and transcription factors that interact with one another. These systems can be programmed to carry out tasks such as detecting a particular molecule and then producing a specific response.

Such circuits can perform different logic functions, but their complexity is limited. Researchers generally need distinct transcription factors for separate operations so that signals do not interfere with one another. Because only a limited number of suitable transcription factors are available, there is a practical ceiling on how complicated a circuit can become inside a single cell. Packing too many circuits into one cell can also overwhelm its protein production machinery.

The MIT team approached the problem differently. Rather than placing an entire circuit inside one cell, they engineered individual cells to serve as transistor-like components that could be connected in different arrangements.

For these components, the researchers used Pantoea agglomerans, a bacterium that commonly grows on surfaces, including plants. They engineered two versions of bacterial transistors that respond to a molecule called...
body.zh: 麻省理工学院的研究人员对细菌进行了改造，使其像晶体管一样工作，创造出可以打印到培养皿内的生长材料上的活“电路板”。 在传统电子产品中，晶体管充当控制电流是否可以通过电路的开关。在麻省理工学院的系统中，工程细菌细胞通过调节小信号分子的运动来发挥类似的作用。然后这些分子将信息携带到生物回路中的其他组件。 研究人员创建了两种类型的细菌晶体管和三种额外的细菌菌株，充当它们之间的中继器。这五种菌株共同提供了一组模块化组件，可以安排这些组件来构建几乎任何类型的电路。在这项新研究中，该团队演示了能够添加两个或三个输入并将单个输入引导至选定目的地的电路。 “我们已经构建了一些常用的初始计算机架构组件，但是任何操作都可以用这五种菌株构建，”麻省理工学院博士后、这项新研究的主要作者、25 岁的 Hamid Doosthosseini 博士说。 一种潜在的用途是将这些活电路放置在植物的叶子或根上。在那里，细菌可以处理有关环境条件的信息，帮助植物检测和应对干旱或害虫袭击等压力。 麻省理工学院生物工程系主任 Christopher Voigt 是该论文的资深作者，该论文最近发表在《自然化学生物学》杂志上。前麻省理工学院博士后陈浩荣也是该论文的作者之一。 合成生物学电路通常由工程细胞构建，以产生彼此相互作用的蛋白质和转录因子。这些系统可以被编程来执行诸如检测特定分子然后产生特定响应等任务。 此类电路可以执行不同的逻辑功能，但其复杂性有限。研究人员通常需要不同的转录因子来进行单独的操作，以便信号不会相互干扰。由于可用的合适转录因子数量有限，因此单个细胞内电路的复杂程度存在实际上限。在一个细胞中装入过多的电路也会压垮其蛋白质生产机器。 麻省理工学院的团队以不同的方式处理这个问题。他们没有将整个电路放置在一个单元内，而是将各个单元设计为类似晶体管的组件，可以以不同的方式连接。 对于这些成分，研究人员使用了成团泛菌，这是一种通常生长在包括植物在内的表面的细菌。他们设计了两种版本的细菌晶体管，它们对一种叫做……的分子做出反应。

reflection.en: The marvels of creation continue to unfold as human ingenuity seeks to understand and harness its intricate systems. These scientists, by observing and re-engineering bacteria, echo the ancient wisdom that creation itself is a source of profound knowledge and understanding. It reminds us that Yahweh's design is complex and worthy of our deepest study and...
reflection.zh: 随着人类的智慧不断探索和利用其错综复杂的系统，创造的奇迹仍在不断展现。这些科学家通过观察和重新设计细菌，呼应了古老的智慧——创造本身就是深刻知识和理解的源泉。这提醒我们，雅伟的设计是复杂的，值得我们最深入的研究和敬畏。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: A longer exhale may push your brain toward bolder decisions
title.zh: 更长的呼气可能会促使您的大脑做出更大胆的决定

summary.en: A new study indicates that slowing breathing with an extended exhale can lead to increased risk-taking. This effect is attributed to changes in heart activity and heightened brain sensitivity to rewards, suggesting that breath control can directly impact decision evaluation.
summary.zh: 一项新研究表明，通过延长呼气来放慢呼吸节奏，可以增加人们的冒险意愿。研究发现，这会改变心脏活动并增强大脑对奖励的敏感性，从而影响决策评估。

body.en:
A new study suggests that deliberately changing the rhythm of your breathing can influence how you make decisions by altering activity in both the heart and brain. Researchers from the German Institute of Human Nutrition Potsdam-Rehbruecke (DIfE) and Charité -- Universitätsmedizin Berlin found that longer exhalations increased heart rate variability and made the brain more responsive to rewards, which was associated with bolder choices. The findings were published in Neuron .

Fast breathing and an elevated heart rate are often linked with rapid decision-making. Under pressure, people may become more cautious in an effort to avoid losses, whether they are making an investment, handling a tense workplace situation, or choosing a meal quickly. Slower breathing and a calmer cardiovascular state, by contrast, may encourage a more positive assessment of potential outcomes and make people more willing to take risks.

Decision-making has traditionally been viewed as a process centered mainly in the brain. The new research examined a broader possibility: that signals from other parts of the body can change brain activity and influence the choices people make.

The study was led by Prof. Soyoung Q Park in collaboration with researchers from institutions including the Neuroscience Research Center at Charité -- Universitätsmedizin Berlin, Freie Universität Berlin, and the German Naval Institute of Maritime Medicine.

"Our decisions are rarely determined solely by external information. Rather, our judgment emerges from the interplay between cognitive processes and our current bodily state. It was previously unknown how the conscious regulation of our body, for example through targeted breathing, could actively control our decision-making process. We wanted to create a physiological shift using a slow breathing pattern to change the quality of our decisions," explains Soyoung Q Park, head of the Department of Decision Neuroscience and Nutrition at DIfE, summarizing the research question.

The researchers studied 41 healthy participants while they made risky choices under carefully controlled breathing conditions. Participants followed visual breathing instructions and either breathed at their normal individual pace or slowed their breathing while extending the exhalation phase (2:8 inhale-exhale ratio).

As the participants completed a series of risk-related decisions, the research team measured several aspects of their physical and neurological responses. Functional magnetic resonance imaging was used to track brain activity, while breathing patterns, heart activity, skin conductance, and pupil responses were monitored at the same time.

This combination of measurements allowed the researchers to test whether extending the exhale...
body.zh: 一项新的研究表明，故意改变呼吸节奏可以通过改变心脏和大脑的活动来影响你的决策方式。德国波茨坦-雷布吕克人类营养研究所 (DIfE) 和柏林夏里特医学大学的研究人员发现，较长的呼气时间会增加心率变异性，并使大脑对奖励更加敏感，这与更大胆的选择有关。研究结果发表在《神经元》杂志上。 呼吸急促和心率升高通常与快速决策有关。在压力下，人们可能会变得更加谨慎，以避免损失，无论是进行投资、处理紧张的工作场所情况，还是快速选择膳食。相比之下，较慢的呼吸和较平静的心血管状态可能会鼓励人们对潜在结果进行更积极的评估，并使人们更愿意冒险。 传统上，决策被视为主要以大脑为中心的过程。这项新研究探讨了更广泛的可能性：来自身体其他部位的信号可以改变大脑活动并影响人们做出的选择。 该研究由 Soyoung Q Park 教授领导，与柏林夏里特医学大学神经科学研究中心、柏林自由大学和德国海军海事医学研究所等机构的研究人员合作。 “我们的决定很少仅由外部信息决定。相反，我们的判断来自认知过程和当前身体状态之间的相互作用。以前不知道我们身体的有意识调节（例如通过有针对性的呼吸）如何能够主动控制我们的决策过程。我们希望利用缓慢的呼吸模式来创造生理转变，以改变我们决策的质量，”DIfE 决策神经科学和营养系主任 Soyoung Q Park 总结了研究问题。 研究人员对 41 名健康参与者进行了研究，他们在严格控制的呼吸条件下做出了危险的选择。参与者遵循视觉呼吸指令，要么以正常的个人节奏呼吸，要么放慢呼吸，同时延长呼气阶段（2:8 吸气-呼气比）。 当参与者完成一系列与风险相关的决定时，研究小组测量了他们身体和神经反应的几个方面。功能性磁共振成像用于跟踪大脑活动，同时监测呼吸模式、心脏活动、皮肤电导和瞳孔反应。 这种测量组合使研究人员能够测试是否延长呼气......

reflection.en: The discovery that simple breath control can alter our decision-making processes is fascinating. It echoes the ancient wisdom that understanding and knowledge are rapidly expanding, as Daniel foretold, urging us to seek wisdom amidst this growth. As we learn more about our own physiology, may we also grow in the wisdom to use this knowledge for good.
reflection.zh: 一项新发现表明，简单的呼吸控制可以改变我们的决策过程，这令人着迷。这呼应了古老的智慧，即知识和理解正在迅速扩展，正如但以理所预言的那样，敦促我们在这种增长中寻求智慧。当我们更多地了解我们自身的生理机能时，愿我们也增长智慧，将这些知识用于善事。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Dying radio galaxies fade faster than scientists expected
title.zh: 衰亡的射电星系比科学家预期的衰退得更快

summary.en: Astronomers have identified a surprisingly young population of fading radio galaxies whose supermassive black holes have already switched off their powerful jets. The confirmed remnants range from about 8 to 42 million years old, suggesting many may disappear from view much faster than previously recognized.
summary.zh: 天文学家发现了一批出乎意料地年轻的、正在消亡的射电星系，其中心的超大质量黑洞已经关闭了强大的喷流。已确认的残骸年龄在800万至4200万年之间，这表明许多星系可能比之前认识到的衰亡速度更快。

body.en: Astronomers have identified a surprisingly young population of fading radio galaxies whose supermassive black holes have already switched off their powerful jets. The confirmed remnants range from about 8 to 42 million years old, suggesting many may disappear from view much faster than previously recognized. More distant remnants also seem to fade especially quickly, helping explain why they have been so difficult to detect.
body.zh: 天文学家发现了一个令人惊讶的年轻衰落射电星系群体，它们的超大质量黑洞已经关闭了它们强大的喷流。已确认的遗迹距今约 8 至 4200 万年，这表明许多遗迹从视野中消失的速度可能比之前认识的要快得多。更遥远的遗迹似乎也消失得特别快，这有助于解释为什么它们如此难以被发现。

reflection.en: The vastness of the cosmos and the intricate workings of celestial bodies continue to reveal themselves through scientific observation. These discoveries, like the fading radio galaxies, remind us that creation itself is a source of profound wisdom and a testament to the Creator's intricate design. As we learn more about the universe, we are invited to...
reflection.zh: 宇宙的浩瀚和天体的复杂运作通过科学观测不断展现出来。这些发现，如同正在消亡的射电星系，提醒我们，创造本身就是智慧的深刻源泉，也是造物主精妙设计的明证。当我们更多地了解宇宙时，我们被邀请去惊叹它的复杂性以及它所提供的知识。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Week in wildlife: a hitchhiking crab, a shy wallaby and penguins in little jackets
title.zh: 本周野生动物：搭便车的螃蟹、害羞的小袋鼠和穿小外套的企鹅

summary.en: This week’s best wildlife photographs from around the world.
summary.zh: 本周来自世界各地的最佳野生动物照片。
